exposure: single-layer locked (SLL) suture technique for uterine incision closure
double-layer unlocked (DLU) suture technique for uterine incision closure
outcome: early histopathological properties of the uterus
cohort: Ten pregnant Wistar-Albino rats underwent cesarean section at term, with right uterine horns repaired using SLL and left using DLU, alongside six uterine horns from three pregnant rats delivered vaginally as controls.
finding: The early histopathological properties, including endometrial and myometrial thickness, of uteri repaired with single-layer locked (SLL) or double-layer unlocked (DLU) techniques were similar.
